question: Why was the linear term for initial dye concentration the most significant term of the quadratic model?
expect: premise false: the linear B term was not significant (p = 0.4196); pH (A) dominated, though B2 was significant (Table 3)
rendered: The linear term for initial dye concentration was not the most significant term of the quadratic model. The linear term for solution pH (A) exerted the strongest effect on Htotal (F = 1606.23, p < 0.0001), followed by monolith dosage (C; F = 81.38, p < 0.0001).
